_comment: Copy to data/bullet-library.json and replace with your real bullets. The role-keys (current / prior1 / prior2 / prior3 / sideproject) are arbitrary names — what matters is that companyKeyMap maps your resume-baseline.json experience[].company strings to role-keys here, and that bulletCounts in your spec uses the same keys.

current.text: EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Built and operate a core internal service used across the org: a REST API handling 50 requests per second at sub-200ms p95, with automated tests and monitoring, adopted by 8 downstream teams.

EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Designed and ran a controlled measurement study comparing two approaches across a 10,000-record dataset, quantifying a 12% improvement and producing recommendations that changed how the team allocates resources.

EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Architected a multi-stage automated workflow that replaced a previously week-long manual process, cutting turnaround time by roughly 80% while improving consistency across 3 teams.

EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Engineered a layered quality and validation system combining cheap automated checks with selective human review: the automated layer caught roughly 85% of issues at near-zero cost, reserving manual review for edge cases.

EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Built a configurable planning and forecasting platform spanning 4 business units and 500+ scenarios, with adaptive per-segment configuration and parallel execution that reduced full-refresh time from hours to minutes.

prior1.text: EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Led an analysis of how resources mapped to outcomes across $X in annual spend, producing allocation recommendations adopted by 3 teams and shifting Y% of spend toward higher-return options.

EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Designed a head-to-head benchmark of 4 candidate approaches with consistent evaluation criteria, deployed the winner across N projects, and replaced the prior default that it outperformed.

prior2.text: EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Rebuilt a core ranking pipeline that lifted qualified throughput from 200 to 2,000 items per month, with $1M+ in incremental revenue attributed.

prior3.text: EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Built risk-assessment models across a $X book of business, flagging the highest-exposure segments for review.

selectedProjects.text: EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Built and operate a scheduled automation side project that runs unattended on a shared runtime, saving roughly 5 hours of manual work per week.
EXAMPLE (replace with your own) Open-source reproduction of a published paper or benchmark: describe the dataset, the variants you compared, and your evaluation methodology.
